data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter bindings for unified native system APIs like windows, tray icons, and dialogs.
data.what_it_does: Provides unified access to native system APIs including windows, tray icons, menus, displays, keyboard, dialogs, and storage across Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows. It can be used in plain Dart without Flutter or with Flutter via nativeapi_flutter.
use_when: You need native desktop window management, tray icons, or display information in Dart or Flutter.
You want to build native views and custom window chrome from plain Dart or Flutter.
avoid_when: You only need web-specific browser APIs without desktop native bindings.
strengths: Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Usable in both plain Dart and Flutter applications.
Provides multi-window bridge and custom window chrome helpers for Flutter.
weaknesses: Under active development and work in progress.
Some native features like moving via DragToMoveArea are not yet implemented on Linux.
data.setup_notes: Add nativeapi or nativeapi_flutter as a dependency to your pubspec.yaml.
